arguments.command:
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor:/workspace/submission timeout 170 python3 -c "
import sys, random, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import planner, verify
from stress import build
from probability import window_thresholds
import numpy as np
rng = random.Random(31415)
worst=0; wc=None; bad=0
for F in (1,2,4,8,16,32):
    for G in (0,2,8,32):
        c = build(rng, 512, 256, F, G, 1, 1, True)
        if not c['windows']: continue
        t0=time.time(); res = planner.solve_epoch(c); el=time.time()-t0
        n=len(c['windows'])
        feats=np.array([w[7] for w in c['windows']],dtype=np.int64).reshape(n,9,2)
        preds=__import__('testcnnonnx' if c['model']=='cnn' else 'testrnnonnx').evaluate_model_single_pass(feats,np.zeros(n,dtype=np.int64))
        th=window_thresholds(c['stats'],c['windows'])
        values=[c['windows'][j][6]*c['class_values'][preds[j]] for j in range(n)]
        errs=verify.verify(c,res,th,values)
        if errs: print('F%d G%d ERRS'%(F,G),errs[:3]); bad+=1
        if el>worst: worst=el; wc=(F,G,res['ratio'])
        print('F=%d G=%d %.2fs ratio=%s served=%d'%(F,G,el,res['ratio'],sum(1 for a in res['assignment'] if a>=0)))
print('worst %.2f'%worst, wc, 'bad',bad, 'peakMB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
" 2>&1 | tail -26
